title: Helwit Acai Nicotine Pouches 7mg / Pouch
description: Helwit Acai Nicotine Pouches deliver a bold berry-inspired flavour with a slightly tart finish. The taste draws from the distinctive character of Acai berries, offering a deeper, more complex profile than typical fruit blends. Rich, tangy and subtly sweet, it's a pouch that rewards a slower pace. Each pouch contains 7mg of nicotine and is made from soft, plant-based fibres for comfort and discretion. Designed to sit neatly under the lip, these pouches release nicotine gradually with no smoke, vapour or odour. Crafted in Sweden using climate-compensated methods, Acai is ideal for pouch users who enjoy darker fruit flavours with a bit of edge. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
